arxiv-2101-01815.title: Efficient Reachability Analysis of Closed-Loop Systems with Neural Network Controllers
arxiv-2101-01815.creator: Michael Everett, Golnaz Habibi, Jonathan P. How
arxiv-2101-01815.description: Abstract Neural Networks (NNs) can provide major empirical performance improvements for robotic systems, but they also introduce challenges in formally analyzing those systems’ safety properties. In particular, this work focuses on estimating the forward reachable set of closed-loop systems with NN controllers.

arxiv-2211-10426.title: Surface-dominated conductance scaling in Weyl semimetal NbAs
arxiv-2211-10426.creator: Sushant Kumar, Yi-Hsin Tu, Luo Sheng, Nicholas A. Lanzillo, Tay-Rong Chang, Gengchiau Liang, Ravishankar Sundararaman, Hsin Lin, Ching-Tzu Chen
arxiv-2211-10426.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sushant Kumar, Yi-Hsin Tu, Luo Sheng, Nicholas A. Lanzillo, Tay-Rong Chang, Gengchiau Liang, Ravishankar Sundararaman, Hsin Lin, Ching-Tzu Chen. Protected surface states arising from non-trivial bandstructure topology in semimetals can potentially enable advanced device functionalities in compute, memory, interconnect, sensing, and communication. This necessitates a fundamental understanding of surface-state transport in nanoscale topological semimetals. Here, we investigate quantum transport in a prototypical topological semimetal NbAs to evaluate the potential of this class of materials for beyond-Cu interconnects in highly-scaled integrated circuits.

arxiv-2211-15717.title: Learning deep abdominal CT registration through adaptive loss weighting and synthetic data generation
arxiv-2211-15717.creator: Javier Pérez de Frutos
arxiv-2211-15717.description: Abstract Abstract Purpose: This study aims to explore training strategies to improve convolutional neural network-based image-to-image deformable registration for abdominal imaging. Methods: Different training strategies, loss functions, and transfer learning schemes were considered. Furthermore, an augmentation layer which generates artificial training image pairs on-the-fly was proposed, in addition to a loss layer that enables dynamic loss weighting.

arxiv-2303-01569.title: Chemically Transferable Generative Backmapping of Coarse-Grained Proteins
arxiv-2303-01569.creator: Soojung Yang, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli
arxiv-2303-01569.description: Abstract Coarse-graining (CG) accelerates molecular simulations of protein dynamics by simulating sets of atoms as singular beads. Backmapping is the opposite operation of bringing lost atomistic details back from the CG representation. While machine learning (ML) has produced accurate and efficient CG simulations of proteins, fast and reliable backmapping remains a challenge.

arxiv-2312-16332.title: 2RV+HRV and Testing for Strong VS Full Dependence
arxiv-2312-16332.creator: Tiandong Wang
arxiv-2312-16332.description: Abstract Preferential attachment models of network growth are bivariate heavy tailed models for in- and out-degree with limit measures which either concentrate on a ray of positive slope from the origin or on all of the positive quadrant depending on whether the model includes reciprocity or not. Concentration on the ray is called full dependence.

arxiv-2403-15332.title: Search for light long-lived particles in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV using displaced vertices in the ATLAS inner detector
arxiv-2403-15332.description: Abstract A search for long-lived particles (LLPs) using 140 fb -1 of p ​ p pp collision data with s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV recorded by the ATLAS experiment at the LHC is presented. The search targets LLPs with masses between 5 5 and 55 55 GeV that decay hadronically in the ATLAS inner detector.

arxiv-2503-09350.title: Non-linear Quasi-Normal Modes of the Schwarzschild Black Hole from the Penrose Limit
arxiv-2503-09350.creator: Alex Kehagias, Davide Perrone, Antonio Riotto
arxiv-2503-09350.description: Abstract The Penrose limit connects a plane wave geometry to the photon ring of a black hole, where the quasi-normal modes are located in the eikonal limit. Utilizing this simplification, we analytically extract the quadratic-level non-linearities in the quasi-normal modes of a Schwarzschild black hole for the ( ℓ × ℓ ) → 2 ​ ℓ (\ell\times\ell)\to 2\ell channel.

arxiv-2510-01589.title: Orbital Period Changes of Recurrent Nova U Scorpii Demonstrate that M ejecta =26 × \times M accreted and Is Not a Type Ia Supernova Progenitor Facilities: AAVSO, TESS
arxiv-2510-01589.creator: Bradley E. Schaefer, Gordon Myers
arxiv-2510-01589.description: Abstract Recurrent nova U Scorpii (U Sco) is one of the prototypes for a Type Ia supernova progenitor. The logic is that the white dwarf is near the Chandrasekhar mass and gas is accumulating onto its surface at a near-maximal accretion rate, so it will soon increase its mass to the supernova trigger.

arxiv-2510-17955.title: Sub-Snowline Formation of Gas-Giant Planets in Binary Systems
arxiv-2510-17955.creator: Ilay Kamai, Hagai B. Perets, Jakob Stegmann, Evgeni Grishin
arxiv-2510-17955.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ilay Kamai, Hagai B. Perets, Jakob Stegmann, Evgeni Grishin. Giant planets are thought to build their cores beyond the “snow line”, where water ice solids catalyze efficient planetary core growth ( Pollack et al. 1996 ; Armitage 2024 ) . In close binary star systems, however, the companion star’s gravity shrinks the region where orbits are long-term stable ( Holman and Wiegert 1999 ) , effectively excluding the zone where giants should form.

arxiv-2511-01049.title: Non Fermi-Liquid Magnetoresistance Oscillations in Quasi-One-Dimensional Conductors
arxiv-2511-01049.creator: A.G. Lebed ∗
arxiv-2511-01049.description: Abstract We theoretically demonstrate that strong non Fermi-liquid magnetic oscillations of electron-electron scattering time can exist in quasi-one-dimensional (Q1D) conductors under condition of the magnetic breakdown between two open electron orbits. They are shown to be due to electron-electron interactions in a metallic phase under condition of the magnetic breakdown and they are beyond the Fermi-liquid theory.

arxiv-2511-05944.title: PolyMap: Generating High Definition Map based on Rasterized Polygons
arxiv-2511-05944.creator: Shiyu Gao, Hao Jiang
arxiv-2511-05944.description: Abstract The perception of high-definition maps is an integral component of environmental perception in autonomous driving systems. Existing research have often focused on online construction of high-definition maps. For instance, the Maptr 9 series employ a detection-based method to output vectorized map instances parallelly in an end-to-end manner.

arxiv-2601-20044.title: Quantum Channels on Graphs: a Resonant Tunneling Perspective
arxiv-2601-20044.creator: Giuseppe Catalano, Farzad Kianvash, Vittorio Giovannetti
arxiv-2601-20044.description: Abstract Quantum transport on structured networks is strongly influenced by interference effects, which can dramatically modify how information propagates through a system. We develop a quantum-information-theoretic framework for scattering on graphs in which a full network of connected scattering sites is treated as a quantum channel linking designated input and output ports.

pmc-11456744.title: Extra‐Articular Abscess Expansion as a Specific Complication of Septic Arthritis of the Shoulder Joint: Report of Three Cases with Extension of the Infection through the Biceps Groove Producing a Large Abscess
pmc-11456744.creator: Jong‐Hun Ji, Darshil Parikh, Byung‐Jun Hwang, Jinyoung Jeong, Seungbae Oh
pmc-11456744.description: BackgroundSeptic arthritis of shoulder is a rare clinical entity as the metaphysis is extracapsular and there is no communication between epiphyseal and metaphyseal vessels. Septic arthritis of the shoulder joint is a diagnostic and surgical emergency because joint destruction develops rapidly and can cause significant morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11664080.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction and mitophagy in ADHD: Cellular and molecular mechanisms
pmc-11664080.creator: Mohammed M. Almutairi, Abdulrahman Althekair, Fahad Almutairi, Mohammed Alatabani, Abdulaziz Alsaikhan
pmc-11664080.description: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by persistent, age-inappropriate levels of inattention and/or hyperactive-impulsive behaviors. Previous investigations reveal that disrupted mitochondrial physiological homeostasis may contribute to ADHD. Several factors, including environmental factors, metabolic dysregulation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and genetic abnormalities, can lead to mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired mitophagic pathways.

pmc-12658259.title: Associations of adverse childhood experiences and depressive symptoms among children and adolescents: the mediating effect of resilience and sleep quality
pmc-12658259.creator: Wenping Ji, Lewei Liu, Pei Tang, Lili Zhao, Zhaoyan Wen, Guangbo Qu, Yu Chen, Huanzhong Liu, Yehuan Sun
pmc-12658259.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) may precipitate depressive symptoms among children and adolescents, yet whether resilience and sleep quality jointly mediate this link remains unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate these potential mediating pathways. From April to June 2023, a total of 3258 children and adolescents were included for this cross-sectional study from 11 primary and secondary schools in Chaohu City, Anhui Province, China. We used a series of scales to assess their depressive symptoms, ACEs, resilience, and sleep quality.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2142.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2142.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 54 (Transportation, Sale, And Handling Of Certain Animals). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary is authorized to promulgate humane standards and recordkeeping requirements governing the purchase, handling, or sale of animals, in commerce, by dealers, research facilities, and exhibitors at auction sales and by the operators of such auction sales.
